public.name: Temescal Hair Co.

campaign.name: Fall 2026 New Client Push
campaign.goal: Fill October and early November chairs with first-time clients from Oakland, Berkeley and SF who become 10-week regulars. Success is booking-link taps and new-client bookings, not reach.

wanted_deliverables.notes: Filmed in the chair, tag @temescalhair, link sticker to booking page

public.brand_voice: Warm, direct, a little cheeky. Talks like a stylist who has heard every hair horror story and isn't fazed. Never says luxury or transformation. Short sentences, first names.
content_guidelines: Film in the chair, in the shop; the salon on screen is the point
Show the service happening (foils, the cut, the blowout); before and after welcome
Name the stylist; clients book people, not shops
Tag @temescalhair, link sticker to the booking page, FTC disclosure
Creator's own words about how the appointment felt; no script
Natural light from the front windows or the shop's ring lights
no_gos: No before shots that mock a previous stylist or another salon by name
No discount codes above 15% for first visits
No content filmed outside the salon presented as the salon's work
No chemical-service claims (damage-free, permanent) the shop can't back up
No perpetual usage rights; organic plus 30-day paid reposts is the ceiling

custom: Feature on the salon's Instagram and in-shop screen
Early access to new stylist openings and event nights

concession_rules.notes: Open at 60% of per-creator max as services first (color session, cut), plus the IG feature and event early access which cost almost nothing. Each round add up to 15% of max: more services, store credit or booking-referral points before cash. Cash last and in small steps. Walk after round 6.

priorities: Service actually received and shown on camera, in the chair
Creator is an Oakland/Berkeley/SF local with a local audience
Booking link sticker in every story
Stylist named on screen or in caption
Service-heavy mixes over cash (services cost ~33% of retail)
walk_away_if: Creator demands cash only with no services in the package
Deliverables would not be filmed in the salon
All-in cost (cash + service cost + credit at 50% + custom) exceeds 900 USD
Creator asks for perpetual usage rights or refuses FTC disclosure
Creator insists on a first-visit discount code above 15%
